correctness.rationale: Strictly concave payoff gives x_i=max(0,theta_i-x_successor), and functional digraphs reduce to directed cycles plus uniquely backward-propagated trees. Composing T_a yields a clipped affine map with sign (-1)^m, alternating offset and explicit bounds; an odd cycle has a unique fixed point, an even cycle has a singleton unless offset=0 when the full interval is fixed. Product of independent cycle intervals is homeomorphic to the entire equilibrium set, whose dimension equals the number of balanced nondegenerate even cycles. Generic uniqueness holds off finitely many proper hyperplanes; the balanced 2-cycle demonstrates discontinuous selection under asymmetric perturbations. Independently checked exact rational boundary examples including balanced-but-singleton six-cycle. O(n) concerns arithmetic operations, not bit complexity.
